verdict.rationale: Alloy documents outbound webhooks that fire on asynchronous events such as a manual review, with signed payloads and 24-hour retries. That gives a developer a way to push review decisions to an external system. Its workflows generate investigations, and the reference mentions Investigations endpoints, but nothing documents a sync with another case-management system. missing for 10: documented Investigations API read/write for external sync, inbound updates from an external case system, investigation-level webhook event types and payloads, a named case-management connector, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can synchronize investigations and decisions with another case-management system
